title: W3C/OGC Semantic Sensor Network Ontology (SOSA/SSN), Recommendation 19 October 2017

w3c-sosa-ssn-FeatureOfInterest.how: the Recommendation's example ice-core-sosa.ttl, byte for byte as W3C serves it (app/specs/senses/spec.json), uses sosa:FeatureOfInterest and is an acceptance vector of the senses guest, which holds the term to its kind in the pinned ontology; prismpm build runs it and GU-01 holds the pinned wasm to those vectors
